kind: HTML/SVG comparison specification; not a Unity implementation or live state
sourceRights: Existing project-authored resources reused as references. This JSON contains original style instructions; no external images, generated bitmaps, purchases or new third-party licences. Existing asset provenance remains authoritative.

observed.minimap: Olive terrain and olive translucent map merge; thin pale rings have little separation from the grass. Feather must remain visible at the outer edge.
observed.skills: Distinct sword, rotation and downward impact glyphs already exist, but small muted faces inside dark circular discs and square slots reduce visual force at actual size.
observed.vitals: Inset capsule-like fills leave conspicuous dark lateral spaces. Reference is 8000/10000 and 9000/10000: those are sample partial values and must not be relabelled as full.

comparisonRules.label: 비교용 합성 시안 · Unity 구현 결과 아님
comparisonRules.minimap: Top right rectangle; green self centred, grey player, red monster; N and 20m/40m preserved; identical marker positions in A/B/C.
comparisonRules.skills: Bottom centre, exactly Z/X/C, same slot sizes. Key labels at least 16px at 1280x720, ivory on dark plaque, outside glyph silhouette. No extra skill or fake readiness claims.
comparisonRules.vitals: Bottom right, unchanged overall footprint. Show equal 100% HP and MP for the full-gauge comparison, explicitly labelled full-gauge design example. Add small 65% geometry swatch only if useful; never imply it is live state.
comparisonRules.presentation: Compare categories independently: map row A/B/C, skill row A/B/C, gauge row A/B/C. Each row has a whole-scene view plus a same-scale crop. Do not present A/B/C as forced complete packages.

decisionAxes: 배경과 확실히 분리되는 강한 대비 ↔ 장면에 자연스럽게 녹는 부드러운 대비
큰 실루엣과 색면 ↔ 얇은 판타지 장식

A.name: 먹색 지도판
A.effect: 짙은 판 위에서 지형·표식이 가장 빠르게 읽힙니다.
A.tradeoff: 패널 존재감이 강해 화면을 조금 더 차지해 보임 · 제작 부담 낮음
A.feather: Only outermost 8% alpha feather; terrain centre remains crisp; no opaque rectangle under feather. Corner accents 8px, no heavy ornament.

B.name: 청록 대비 + 밝은 표식
B.effect: 차가운 지도색과 밝은 테두리로 풀밭에서도 표식이 또렷합니다.
B.tradeoff: 현재 올리브 지도보다 색 인상이 달라짐 · 제작 부담 낮음~중간
B.feather: Outer 14% fades smoothly; rings and markers use same fade. Halo is a crisp narrow rim, not blurred bloom. Centre retains 100% marker opacity.

C.name: 넓게 스며드는 지도
C.effect: 중앙은 선명하고 가장자리는 장면으로 넓게 스며듭니다.
C.tradeoff: 가장자리 개체와 지형은 A/B보다 덜 선명함 · 제작 부담 중간
C.feather: Wide 24% edge fade on ALL map layers; central 52% untouched. Keep labels in solid central-safe zone or anchored outside mask. No visible border enclosing the fade.

base.cooldown: Existing radial cooldown remains integration constraint; comparison shows ready art only.

A.name: 크게 읽히는 문장
A.effect: 칼·회전·내려찍기 형태를 크게 키워 한눈에 구별합니다.
A.tradeoff: 가장 담백한 안이라 장식적인 게임 맛은 B/C보다 약함 · 제작 부담 낮음
A.shape: Rounded shield-like slot with 10px corners, very slight bottom taper. Enlarge existing glyph to 82% inner height; dark 1.6px silhouette separator. Keep one broad curved slash per icon; no filigree.
A.frame: 0.8px pale rim, 2px dark outer separation; little or no glow. Key plaque overlaps upper left by 4px.

B.name: 마력 색면
B.effect: 청록·호박·푸른 색면과 밝은 문양으로 스킬의 존재감을 높입니다.
B.tradeoff: 셋 중 가장 화려하며 쿨다운 때 색면이 어두워지는 조정 필요 · 제작 부담 중간
B.shape: Three rounded faceted medallions, not three plain flat discs. Each has a broad crescent colour-face occupying lower-left 35% and a darker upper-right plane; use no more than 3 flat colours per glyph. Existing recognisable silhouettes enlarged to 76%.
B.frame: 1.2px warm ivory rim and 2px dark silhouette. Thin inner coloured crescent highlight, no photoreal metal texture. Key plaque solid deep teal with warm 1px edge.

C.name: 얇은 룬 프레임
C.effect: 굽은 얇은 프레임과 작은 모서리 문양으로 판타지 장비감을 더합니다.
C.tradeoff: 축소 화면에서 작은 장식은 약해져 A/B만큼 강렬하지 않음 · 제작 부담 중간
C.shape: Rounded square medallion with bowed sides, clipped 6px corners; 1.2px curved gold frame with four short diamond terminals. Reuse existing glyph at 74% height and increase face lightness. Two broad colour faces remain visible behind it.
C.frame: Keep ornaments at perimeter; never draw over glyph or key. 1px inner dark line and 1px outer pale accent only; no nested stack of full frames.

base.fullDefinition: At100%, the coloured fill covers the entire available inner track from left to right, including rounded ends. Clip fill with the same track shape; no decorative unfilled endcap. Actual values always control fill in product.

A.name: 빈틈없는 색면
A.effect: 전체 트랙을 채우는 넓은 빨강·파랑 면으로 꽉 찬 상태가 즉시 보입니다.
A.tradeoff: 형태는 가장 간결하며 장식성은 B/C보다 낮음 · 제작 부담 낮음
A.shape: Two horizontal rounded rectangles, radius5, 1px rim. Full fill reaches all inner bounds; top third slightly lighter in a broad flat band. One 2px lower dark strip gives depth. Text centred on fill; HP/MP labels aligned left inside fill.
A.panel: One low-opacity dark curved backing, no separate thick black boxes per row. Full width minus 2px rim is usable fill width.

B.name: 보석 끝장식
B.effect: 작은 붉은·푸른 보석과 밝은 테두리가 자원 게이지를 눈에 띄게 합니다.
B.tradeoff: 왼쪽 보석만큼 수치 영역이 줄어듦 · 제작 부담 중간
B.shape: Small 14px faceted diamond at left, track begins behind its right half. All track fills to right tip at100%; warm thin rim and tiny left curl only. No orb and no large portrait. Label HP/MP beside gemstone, numeric text centred on remaining bar.
B.panel: Shared curved backing within same footprint. Gem is decorative and does not create a false unfilled track segment.

C.name: 굽은 리본 게이지
C.effect: 살짝 굽은 끝과 선명한 상단 색면으로 부드럽지만 게임다운 인상을 만듭니다.
C.tradeoff: 곡선 끝에서 비율 판단이 A보다 조금 덜 직관적 · 제작 부담 중간
C.shape: Horizontal ribbon with shallow convex top and tapered 6px right point; fill clipped to exact ribbon shape.100% reaches right point; HP/MP lettering on left and centred numeric value. Upper40% is one lighter face with tiny lower dark bevel.
C.panel: No broad rectangular backing; use narrow 2px dark silhouette directly around each coloured ribbon. Keep entire footprint unchanged.

recommendation.reason: 청록 지도와 밝은 표식으로 대비를 확보하고, 스킬은 큰 색면으로 살리며, HPMP는 빈틈없는 채움으로 가장 직접적으로 개선합니다. 세 부분의 금빛은 얇은 테두리에만 제한합니다.
recommendation.status: Recommendation only; no user choice or product approval inferred.

integrationNotes: Do not repaint or replace existing native PNGs merely for this comparison; coordinator may recolour broad SVG faces or compose existing PNGs over distinct frames as clearly labelled options.
Native SVG/CSS mock-up geometry is appropriate; no new bitmap generation is needed for this scope.
Skill B should look colourful without blurred bloom, detailed metal texture or a black square tile overpowering the glyph.
Check full-scene views at1280x720 and cropped views without artificial upscaling as evidence of actual game-size readability.
User chooses category independently. Full-gauge example is visual only; product must continue showing current/max and real ratios.
